research_snapshot.reported_mechanism: Public /daily-sales/clearance and /daily-sales/closeout show finite promotional lists, explicit was/current prices and countdown-style clearance offers. Document hidden continuation or filter state from browser capture.

research_snapshot.known_risks: Retailer renaming of identical generic OEM models, bulky shipping and product option ranges may preclude exact match. Some page prices are per item in multipacks; preserve quantity.
